entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A centuries-old planeswalker hero and formidable time mage who saved his homeland by phasing it out of time.

events.summary: Teferi saves his homeland from war by phasing it out of time.
events.quote: he once saved his homeland from war by phasing it out of time.

events.summary: During the ensuing conflict Teferi loses his planeswalker spark along with much of his power.
events.quote: Teferi lost his Planeswalker spark along with much of his power

events.summary: Teferi moves on to raise a family, who grow old while he remains almost untouched by age.
events.quote: Teferi eventually moved on to raise a family, but after many years they grew old while he remained almost untouched by age.

events.summary: New threats to the Multiverse inspire Teferi to reclaim his planeswalker spark.
events.quote: new threats to the Multiverse finally inspired him to reclaim his Planeswalker spark.
